intro.uz: Aziz eng yaqin doʻsti Temur haqida yozadi. Oʻqishdan oldin: doʻstingiz qanday odam?

paragraphs.en: My name is Aziz. My best friend is Timur. We are in the same class. Timur is tall and thin. He has short black hair and brown eyes. He always wears a blue cap.
paragraphs.uz: Mening ismim Aziz. Eng yaqin doʻstim — Temur. Biz bir sinfda oʻqiymiz. Temur baland boʻyli va ozgʻin. Uning sochi kalta va qora, koʻzlari jigarrang. U doim koʻk kepka kiyib yuradi.

paragraphs.en: Timur is very good at maths, but he isn't good at English. I help him with his English homework, and he helps me with maths.
paragraphs.uz: Temur matematikani juda yaxshi biladi, lekin ingliz tilini yaxshi bilmaydi. Men unga ingliz tili uy vazifasida yordam beraman, u esa menga matematikada yordam beradi.

paragraphs.en: After school, we often play football in the park. At the weekend, we sometimes go to the cinema. Timur likes action films, and I like comedies.
paragraphs.uz: Darsdan keyin biz tez-tez bogʻda futbol oʻynaymiz. Dam olish kunlari baʼzan kinoga boramiz. Temur jangari filmlarni yoqtiradi, men esa komediyalarni.

glossary.uz: … ni yaxshi bilmoq, … ga usta boʻlmoq

title.uz: Tashqi koʻrinish: He has short black hair

grammar.example: He has short black hair and brown eyes.
We often play football in the park.

questions.statement: Timur and Aziz are in the same class.

explain.uz: «he isn't good at English» — ingliz tilini yaxshi bilmaydi.

questions.prompt: Who helps Timur with his English homework?

explain.uz: «My name is Aziz… I help him with his English homework» — yordam beradigan Aziz.

questions.statement: The boys often play football after school.

explain.uz: «After school, we often play football in the park.»

questions.prompt: At the weekend, the boys sometimes go to the ___.

explain.uz: Temur — jangari filmlar; komediyalarni Aziz yoqtiradi.
